questions.enonce_markdown: **Topic 2.** You have noticed that more and more people are going back to old traditional practices even in the cities. Write an essay in which you describe a traditional ceremony you witnessed. What was it all about? When did it take place? What activities were carried out? Who were the participants? What is the importance of this ceremony to the people? What was your impression about the ceremony? *(200-250 words)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Une composition qui raconte un événement vécu suit l'ordre chronologique (introduction qui situe le lieu et le moment, déroulement des faits, bilan et impression personnelle) et mêle récit au passé et description des personnes, des lieux et des objets. Chaque question de la consigne (quoi, quand, activités, participants, importance, impression) devient une partie du texte, de façon à ne rien oublier.

La consigne contient six questions, chacune devenant une partie du texte : de quoi s'agissait-il, quand, quelles activités, quels participants, quelle importance, quelle impression. Le récit d'un événement vécu se rédige au passé (*took place*, *was dressed*) ; l'importance de la cérémonie se dit au présent, car c'est une vérité générale.

**Essai modèle (226 mots)**

**A Traditional Wedding Ceremony**

Last December, during the holidays, I witnessed a traditional wedding ceremony in my grandfather's village. It was all about the marriage of my cousin Mireille to her fiancé, Paul, and the official meeting of their two families.

The ceremony took place on Saturday morning in the family compound and lasted until late in the night. Many activities were carried out. First, the representatives of the groom's family presented the bride price: goats, bags of salt, bottles of palm wine and kola nuts. Then the elders blessed the couple and poured a libation to ask the ancestors for protection. After that, the bride, dressed in a beautiful traditional outfit, came out dancing among her friends and offered a cup of palm wine to her future husband. Finally, everybody enjoyed a big meal and danced to the rhythm of drums and songs until midnight.

The participants were the two families, the village elders, neighbours, friends and a group of traditional dancers.

This ceremony is very important to the people because it unites two families, respects the customs of our ancestors and teaches children the value of our culture. It also strengthens solidarity in the community.

As for me, I was deeply impressed. I admired the joy, the colours and the respect shown to the elders. I understood that our traditions must be kept alive, even in modern cities.

### Piège à éviter
Ne glisse pas du passé au présent en cours de récit : l'événement s'est déroulé, tous les faits racontés restent au prétérit, et seul le commentaire sur l'importance de la cérémonie passe au présent.

### Conseil
Recopie les six questions de la consigne au brouillon et coche chacune au fur et à mesure de ta rédaction : c'est la manière la plus sûre de ne rien oublier.
